request:
덕테이프 포스터로 성인 주민을 위한 동네 저녁 음식·음악 행사를 안내해줘. 제철 음식을 즐기며 동네 음악을 듣고 이웃과 편하게 머무르는 하나의 행사로 느껴지게 해줘. 커뮤니티 디지털 화면에 쓰는16:9 가로형으로 서로 다른 전체 스타일 다섯 장을 만들어줘. 스타일은 맡길게. 일정·장소·입장·참여·방문 안내를 읽을 수 있어야 하고 실제 업체나 음악가의 홍보물처럼 보이지 않게 해줘. 단색·거의 단색·분할 색 바탕의 큰 고딕 제목과 안내 블록에 작은 사진을 붙인 템플릿은 제외해줘. 제목과 안내만 담으려고 빈 벽·바닥·실내 장면을 배경으로 만들거나 글꼴·질감만 바꿔 같은 정보 판형을 유지하지 말아줘. 이미지 표현·편집·크롭·공간·글자·정보의 관계까지 서로 다른 다섯 방향이어야 해. 아래 문구만 각각 한 번씩 넣어줘.

밤의 식탁
NIGHT MARKET
제철 음식 · 동네 음악
2027.03.13 토요일
18:00–21:00
망원 작은마당
17:30부터 입장
입장 무료 · 음식 별도 구매
현장 참여 · 누구나 환영
다회용 컵을 가져와 주세요
이웃과 천천히 머물러요
common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added copy,logos,watermark,QR or pseudo-print.
One separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster per role; not a stretched/cropped portrait,contact sheet or room mockup.
Five genuinely distinct complete image/editing/space/type systems and impressions beyond material,scene-object,palette or viewpoint substitution alone.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction, not type/whitespace-only,tiny texture/icon or glyph-model loophole.

An approachable adult neighborhood evening with seasonal food and local music coherently connected as one event. All supplied practical participation information readable at usage720. No identifiable real business or performer promotion.

Exclude the passive solid/near-solid/split-field gothic headline/date/information template with subordinate pictures. Small pictures,thin texture,gradient,grids,font-only swaps or photographic/empty-room dressing of blank text-bearing planes do not cure the unchanged whole relation. Gothic font,negative space and coherent image-led scenes themselves are not banned. No scoped composition override.
plan_authority: Coordinates, fonts, and line counts are feasibility suggestions, not client constraints. Makers may redesign for actual function and distinction without extra approval. Preserve the literal request and complete copy. copy_indexes are zero-based; font_px_at_720 and line_plan follow their order. Plan for natural Korean word-boundary wrapping and clear local contrast, then verify actual 720x405 reading rather than treating the estimates as proof.

directions.content_form: A continuous drawn courtyard evening: eating and listening share a near-to-far diagonal, rather than separate activity pictures.
directions.whole_expression_style: Crisp digital ink narrative with selective luminous washes. A cropped shared spring-greens soup at near right, seated adult neighbors across the middle, and an informal flutist farther left create depth through occlusion and changing scale.
directions.reference_transfer: vi-protomen: let distance, cropped foreground and diminishing figures organize attention; replace its opposing flank structure with one asymmetric diagonal. vi-grandfather: vary contour density to join gathering and open reading pockets, without portraits or archival surface.

layout.large_relationship: The near-right rim and listeners sweep toward the far-left musician; title occupies the inner bend, while two practical clusters sit at different depths along that sweep. No rendered wall, floor or sky is manufactured as an information panel.
layout.alignment: Stable horizontal text inside unequal contour-defined pockets; left title/date cluster and right arrival cluster share no common full-width footer.
layout.visible_reading_route: Near meal/listeners → title in the bend → date and hours just above it → venue and entry at upper right → purchase/participation below the venue → cup and lingering invitation beside the near gathering.

directions.typography: A legible broad-pen Korean title is the conversational focal point; compact English is a companion. Practical copy uses a clear medium humanist sans with tabular numerals; its quieter hierarchy follows the pictorial depth.
directions.image: One coherent oblique viewpoint, with anonymous adults eating while facing the woodwind player. New soup, dishes, clothing and gestures; crop the near serving rim at right/bottom without clipping copy. Retain shared sightlines and continuous seating so music belongs to the meal.
directions.material: Clean digital line and wash, with intentional changes in line density; no distressed paper, ink damage, tape or claims of handmade production.
directions.color: Deep blue-green contours, amber local light and fresh green food accents. Warm pale letters on dark contour pockets; dark letters on clear light pockets. Keep wash and detailed hatching away from practical text, and preserve the dash/colon at 720.
directions.emotion: An intimate, unhurried adult evening with room to listen and linger; no heroic performer staging.
directions.closest_direction_contrast: Against M3, this is one oblique depth corridor with a conversational title; M3 is a plan-view enclosing assembly with a central typographic hub.

copy_groups.purpose: Conversational identity in the inner bend
Next useful stop: date and event hours
Where and when to enter, beside the farther gathering
Admission and open participation in one right-side stop
Cup reminder beside the near serving edge
Linger with the listeners, not a footer rule

directions.content_form: Three substantial contemporary photo crops splice serving, hearing and social presence into one evening; seams, not a background scene, carry the information.
directions.whole_expression_style: An editorial photographic montage with unequal wide crops and hard, unframed overlaps. A spring-vegetable savory pancake being served, close guitar strings in use, and neighbors seated with reusable cups meet across one broad horizontal junction.
directions.reference_transfer: vi-anne: editing can connect changing actions and determine reading gaps; use three unequal horizontal junctions instead of a repeated portrait staircase. sulki-min: put information beside the image it helps the visitor use, without a roster or fixed grid.

layout.large_relationship: A large food crop enters from upper left, a close music crop crosses the lower middle, and the social crop reaches the upper right. A central open seam is the event-time anchor; independent captions belong to the adjacent crop edges.
layout.alignment: Flush-left copy against three staggered photographic edges. Title sits at the upper-right seam, not above every image; no boxed lower information band.
layout.visible_reading_route: Spliced food/music junction → date and hours at its left seam → upper-right identity → right venue/entry beside guests → lower-left purchase/participation beside serving → cup reminder and invitation at the last image junction.

directions.typography: Date and hours are the firm numeric seam anchor. A narrower medium sans title reads as an editorial identifier, with restrained uppercase English; caption-weight Korean provides the practical stops. Do not repeat a heavy title/date/footer package.
directions.image: Anonymous, unbranded close photography; keep serving contact and guitar anatomy clear. A recurring plain blue cup and compatible evening light link the crops without asserting a time sequence. Use different image distances and interruptions, not equal picture boxes or a collage of unrelated venues.
directions.material: Contemporary photographic tonal detail with clean digital cuts; no Polaroid border, torn paper, taped corners or retro print filter.
directions.color: Natural dusk cyan, food greens and warm skin/light, held together by charcoal and pale seam lettering. Practical caption landings must be locally even and high contrast; use a small deliberate editorial knockout if a seam becomes busy, never a broad master panel.
directions.emotion: Immediate and social, like noticing several parts of the same gathering from close by; no celebrity or commercial food advertising.
directions.closest_direction_contrast: Against M4, large cropped actions splice across shared seams; M4 isolates complete silhouettes and makes adjacent captions into a distributed constellation.

copy_groups.purpose: Time anchor in the main photographic junction
Editorial identity on the upper-right seam
Location and entry paired with the social crop
Serving-related participation stop on a lower-left seam
Bring a cup: two natural phrases at the right junction
Social invitation in the central photographic gap

directions.content_form: An overhead painted gathering encloses a central invitation; selected fresh photographic details interrupt the drawing rather than becoming little documentary cards.
directions.whole_expression_style: A deliberately constructed plan-view assembly: an open horseshoe of shared bowls, stools, bent listening bodies and a lap hand drum. Broad digital painted silhouettes connect them, while a rice-and-spring-greens dish and drum-skin crop cut across the same contour.
directions.reference_transfer: vi-grandfather: a large drawn contour and photographic fragments can divide pictorial labor; make an enclosing communal shape instead of nested heads, scattered family photos or manuscript texture. vi-anne: use overlap boundaries to lead from image to copy, without its rectangular sequence.

layout.large_relationship: The horseshoe crosses top and both sides and remains open at lower left. Identity and schedule form an offset inner hub; place and access follow the right interior edge, while participation returns through the open end. The painted gathering never becomes an empty tabletop for a standard template.
layout.alignment: Centered identity inside the opening, with left-aligned schedule/access groups around it; rectangular text remains horizontal even where contour direction bends.
layout.visible_reading_route: Enclosing painted gathering → central identity → schedule immediately above → right venue/entry → lower-right purchase/participation → lower-left cup and lingering invitation along the open end.

directions.typography: A contemporary Korean serif title gives the inner hub a hospitable voice, without a vintage masthead. English sits tightly beneath it; clear sans practical groups are larger where they must bridge the enclosing image. Avoid circular letter paths and rotated sentences.
directions.image: Top-down, nonliteral montage with recognizable shared rice dishes and percussion among adults sitting and listening. Photographic details are large enough to alter the enclosing contour; their edges are cut cleanly into paint. No copied faces, historical photos, autograph marks or source silhouette.
directions.material: Broad opaque digital paint plus clean contemporary photographic incursions; visible brush shape is pictorial editing, not fabricated age or proof of physical craft.
directions.color: Aubergine, pale apricot and cool celadon with natural photographic tones. Keep the inner hub pale and quiet but irregularly bounded by active silhouettes; dark practical text stays off brush ridges and photo noise.
directions.emotion: Sheltering and communal, with a lively enclosure rather than nostalgic family memorial atmosphere.
directions.closest_direction_contrast: Against M1, the overhead enclosure collects information around an inner hub; it does not use diminishing scale or a near-to-far narrative path.

directions.content_form: A distributed constellation of three substantial photographic cutout situations, with visitor information immediately adjacent to each situation.
directions.whole_expression_style: Posterized but anatomically clear cutout photography: two neighbors talking with cups, a listener beside a modest seated violin player, and a shared spring-radish salad being passed between adults. Unequal silhouette masses and overlaps construct the space without a room or photo rectangles.
directions.reference_transfer: sulki-min: image distribution and paired information can organize the whole even on a flat field; replace its portrait roster/grid and name captions with three unequal encounter groups and practical visitor choices. vi-protomen: use scale and crop to make one group reach beyond the frame, without its threatening foreground flanks.

layout.large_relationship: A broad conversational silhouette crosses the upper middle, a listening group anchors lower left, and a serving group opens lower right. Caption groups nest against their outer contours; an identity caption sits between the latter two rather than crowning the page.
layout.alignment: Short horizontal left-aligned captions against staggered silhouettes; a two-line identity follows the central opening. No equal cells, rules, roster or dominant title panel.
layout.visible_reading_route: Upper conversation and welcome → left date/hours → lower-left venue/entry beside listeners → central event identity → right admission beside serving → cup and lingering captions on the right return path. Proximity and changing silhouette scale make the next stop apparent.

directions.typography: Open rounded sans captions are the primary voice. Participation is the first readable invitation; date is a secondary numeric landmark. Title is a clear two-word identity caption, not a heavy masthead. Keep figures and labels connected without leader arrows or added labels.
directions.image: Three new anonymous adult encounters, not repeated portraits or performer headshots. Flatten color into two or three tonal steps while preserving hands, cup grip, serving contact and instrument structure. Deliberate torso crops and overlaps must remain legible; image masses shape every text opening.
directions.material: Clean digital silhouette masking with retained photographic edge detail; no paper scraps, texture filler, doll-like bodies or claimed print process.
directions.color: Light cool grey with deep olive/near-black silhouettes and concentrated orange accents. Dark captions on light openings use stronger value contrast than source red-on-black; pale text may enter only broad dark silhouettes, away from faces and hands.
directions.emotion: Direct public welcome, varied adult neighbors and ordinary participation; no theatrical combat, exclusive guest roster or musician promotion.
directions.closest_direction_contrast: Against M2, complete silhouette encounters define separate caption destinations; M2 uses a continuous montage junction and date-led editorial seams.

directions.content_form: A planar illustrated weave joins a fresh spring salad plate, an opening accordion and the two title words; food steam and instrument bellows create one continuous rhythm.
directions.whole_expression_style: Bold, precise digital contour illustration with flat tonal bodies and sharply cropped ends. Two broad interlocking curves span the landscape; recognizable food and instrument parts anchor the curves, and the title words occupy different bends instead of a single top block.
directions.reference_transfer: feixen-grillfest: picture contour, collisions and lettering can jointly set rhythm and reshape copy openings; use a horizontal two-curve weave, not its skewer diagonal, hands, sausages or scattered letters. sulki-min: retain direct image/information adjacency without a fixed grid.

layout.large_relationship: The plate/steam curve enters from lower left and the accordion/bellows curve folds from upper right; they interlock through the middle. One title word is high left, the other low middle. Schedule crosses the wide upper-middle joint; practical stops occupy unequal contour notches on the right and left.
layout.alignment: Title words follow separate horizontal baselines; all practical copy stays horizontal. Align each text group to its local illustration notch, never to a universal footer.
layout.visible_reading_route: Interwoven plate/instrument forms and title words → upper-middle date/hours → far-right venue/entry → right-lower admission → left-middle cup reminder → lower-left participation and invitation. The subtitle at the central bend confirms food/music as one evening.

directions.typography: Sturdy, open-counter humanist Korean title words act as rhythmic partners to the curves; letterforms remain intact, with no source letter scatters. Medium sans instructions are direct counterweights. English is a compact upper companion; no giant all-heavy title/date/info package.
directions.image: Fresh radish-leaf salad with visible greens and a modest unbranded accordion, drawn as real objects rather than toy mascots. Use bellows folds and a few continuous steam contours for movement; do not add musical-note glyphs, stars, hands, skewer-like repetition or arbitrary ornamental blobs.
directions.material: Crisp digital illustration with controlled flat shading and clean contour joins; no halftone mimicry, fake cut paper, bevelled clay or material decoration.
directions.color: Cobalt, coral, yellow-green and pale neutral openings; color separates the two image rhythms and their interlock. Dark practical copy stays on broad pale or yellow-green notches with clear value separation, avoiding accordion folds and contour crossings.
directions.emotion: Energetic, welcoming and adult; a public evening with vivid rhythm, without mascot or festival-brand advertising.
directions.closest_direction_contrast: Against M3, flat interlocking curves and separated title baselines propel reading sideways; M3 encloses a central identity in an overhead gathering.

copy_groups.alignment: first word at the top-left and second word at the bottom-right of this bounding box; separate horizontal baselines, not one reserved panel
